style="shape=note;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fafafa;strokeColor=#b0b0b0;fontSize=11;" value="<b>42U RACK SPECIFICATIONS & THERMAL DESIGN</b><br><br>• <b>Rack Dimension:</b> 42U 19-inch Standard (600mm W x 1000mm D)<br>• <b>Cooling / Airflow:</b> Front-to-Back Airflow with Blanking Panels<br>• <b>Power Distribution:</b> Dual A/B Redundant Feed (2x 16A PDUs)<br>• <b>Battery Backup:</b> 3000VA Online UPS with 15min Full-load Runtime<br>• <b>Cable Management:</b> 1U Horizontal D-Ring Organizers between layers<br><br><b>COLOR LEGEND:</b><br>• <font color='#6c8ebf'><b>Blue:</b></font> WAN & Perimeter Edge Routing (ISR 4331)<br>• <font color='#b85450'><b>Red:</b></font> Edge Security Firewall (ASA 5506-X)<br>• <font color='#9673a6'><b>Purple:</b></font> Core / Distribution Layer (Catalyst 3650)<br>• <font color='#82b366'><b>Green:</b></font> Access Layer Switches (Catalyst 2960)<br>• <font color='#d6b656'><b>Yellow:</b></font> High-Value Compute & Server Farm<br>• <font color='#666666'><b>Gray:</b></font> Power Management & Structured Patch Panels" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="420" width="620" x="700" y="80" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="change_box" parent="1" style="shape=note;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fafafa;strokeColor=#b0b0b0;fontSize=11;" value="<b>PHYSICAL AS-BUILT RECONCILIATION (CHANGE-001)</b><br><br>• <b>Floor 2 Patch Panel:</b> Port 01 physically connected to <code>ACC-F2-01:Fa0/1</code>.<br>• <b>DEV Workstation:</b> Re-routed patch lead to Floor 2 Cat6 field termination.<br>• <b>Audit Status:</b> Physical cabling matches As-Built Switch Port Plan." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="140" width="620" x="700" y="530" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>

div.div:
42U RACK SPECIFICATIONS & THERMAL DESIGN
• Rack Dimension: 42U 19-inch Standard (600mm W x 1000mm D)
• Cooling / Airflow: Front-to-Back Airflow with Blanking Panels
• Power Distribution: Dual A/B Redundant Feed (2x 16A PDUs)
• Battery Backup: 3000VA Online UPS with 15min Full-load Runtime
• Cable Management: 1U Horizontal D-Ring Organizers between layers
COLOR LEGEND:
• Blue: WAN & Perimeter Edge Routing (ISR 4331)
• Red: Edge Security Firewall (ASA 5506-X)
• Purple: Core / Distribution Layer (Catalyst 3650)
• Green: Access Layer Switches (Catalyst 2960)
• Yellow: High-Value Compute & Server Farm
• Gray: Power Management & Structured Patch Panels
